description: For integer classes, addition adds coordinates, negation swaps them, multiplication sends (a,b),(c,d) to (ac+bd,ad+bc), and order compares a+d with c+b.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.integer_representative_formulas (a b c d : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.integerAdd (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.integerClass a b)
        (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.integerClass c d) =
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.integerClass (a + c) (b + d) ∧
    Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.integerNeg (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.integerClass a b) =
        Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.integerClass b a ∧
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.integerMul (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.integerClass a b)
            (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.integerClass c d) =
          Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.integerClass (a * c + b * d) (a * d + b * c) ∧
        (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.IntegerLE (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.integerClass a b)
            (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.integerClass c d) ↔
          a + d ≤ c + b)
